preconditions.description: The number of knitting needles K is between 1 and 50000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi, yi, zi < 1000 for xi, yi, zi in zip(*([int] * 6 * K)))
preconditions.description: Each coordinate of the triples is between 1 and 999.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'True closed chains' if any_true_closed_chain else 'No true closed chains'
postconditions.description: The first line of the output indicates whether there is a true closed chain.

postconditions.expression: return_value[1] == 'Floor closed chains' if any_floor_closed_chain else 'No floor closed chains'
postconditions.description: The second line of the output indicates whether there is a floor closed chain.
